name: opnmesh
description: Self-hosted WireGuard mesh management for small multi-site networks

scripts.ui:test: next build && cross-env RUN_UI_TESTS=1 vitest run test/ui.test.ts --testTimeout 120000
scripts.mesh:up: tsx docker/genconfigs.ts && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml build gw-a && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --force-recreate control
scripts.mesh:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile traffic --profile obs --profile enrol down -v
scripts.mesh:obs: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile obs up -d prometheus alertmanager grafana mailpit
scripts.mesh:traffic: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile traffic up -d traffic-gen
